Your leftovers deserve better than a third microwave tour. 😂🐔

Give that cooked chicken a change of scenery:

🌮 Quesadillas: Shredded chicken, cheese and tortillas. Salsa gets an invitation, too.

🌿 Pesto pasta: Chicken, pasta, pesto and peas. Suddenly, leftovers have plans.

🥣 Chicken noodle soup: Chicken, broth, noodles, carrots and celery. Sweatshirt weather in a bowl.

Three different directions for the chicken you already cooked. Pick whichever fits your fridge—and your patience level tonight.

Save this for the next “what’s for dinner?” meeting nobody volunteered to chair.

Follow Roswell Family Farm in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY, for practical meal ideas and the family behind the farm. 💚

Explore our Chicken Orders page:
https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/chicken-orders.html

BOCES students learning about anatomy and getting a little “out of this world” farm-to-classroom experience. 🐷🔬🫀

It started with a freezer and two people in love.
Well, that escalated quickly. 😂🐔

Now we’ve got a farm and three little chicken tenders: Wyatt on the left, Willow in the middle and Waylon on the right.

New York, meet the Roswells. 💚

We’re Aj and Emily, building our family farm in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY.

Emily works full time at North Star Recycling. I work full time on the farm—building, making improvements, feeding the animals and checking that they’re healthy every day.

Whenever we can be together, we do it together. That’s what makes this a family farm: the time we share caring for the animals and building something of our own.

Whether you’re down the road or across New York, you’re welcome to follow our story.

Come for the chicken outfits. Stay to see what we build next. 🐔🛸
